mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.parent_menu_id AS parentId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_name AS resourceName, m.`desc`, m.resource_type AS resourceType, m.route_path AS routePath, m.icon, m.sort_no AS sortNo, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM operation_user u INNER JOIN operation_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN operation_role r ON r.id = ur.operation_role_id INNER JOIN operation_role_menu rm ON rm.operation_role_id = r.id INNER JOIN operation_menu granted ON granted.id = rm.operation_menu_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1 AND u.valid = 1 AND ur.valid = 1 AND ur.effective_start_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (ur.effective_end_time IS NULL OR ur.effective_end_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND r.status = 1 AND r.valid = 1 AND rm.valid = 1 AND granted.status = 1 AND granted.valid = 1 AND granted.resource_type IN (1, 2) AND (granted.id = m.id OR (rm.include_descendants = 1 AND LEFT(m.men_path, CHAR_LENGTH(granted.men_path) + 1) = CONCAT(granted.men_path, ';'))) ) AS authorized FROM operation_menu m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.valid = 1 AND m.resource_type IN (1, 2) ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
